import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=im.shape[:2]
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv'); b=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv')
print(a.shape,b.shape, (a.columns==b.columns).all())
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=im.copy(); vis0=im.copy()
for (_,r),(_,r0) in zip(b.iterrows(),a.iterrows()):

    cv2.polylines(vis0,[p0],True,(0,0,255),1)
print('max overlap',cnt.max(), 'bbox ok', all((b.xmin<=b.xmax)&(b.ymin<=b.ymax)))
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',np.hstack([cv2.resize(vis0,None,fx=2,fy=2),cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2)]))
